RateStats
.`a perfectly regular 100 Hz stream reports 100 Hz`()
.`achieved rate counts intervals and not events, so one event is not an infinite rate`()
.`an empty stream produces finite zeros rather than NaN`()
.`min mean and max come straight from the timestamps`()
.`a constant interval has zero jitter`()
.`standard deviation matches the sample stdev computed by hand`()
.`stdev needs two intervals before it means anything`()
.`percentiles are the upper edge of a 100 microsecond bin, not an exact quantile`()
.`the reported percentile never understates the interval it describes`()
.`a percentile separates a slow tail from the median`()
.`an interval past the last bin reports the observed maximum, not the bin edge`()
.`a backwards timestamp is counted and never integrated`()
.`a repeated timestamp counts as non-monotonic rather than as a zero interval`()
.`gaps beyond three times the requested period are counted`()
.`a stream with no requested rate reports no gaps rather than dividing by zero`()
.`events that arrive in a burst are counted as batched`()
.`the requested rate is reported back unchanged so the sidecar records what was asked`()
